annotations.title: Wanchain address Bridge to Earn activity

description: Bridge to Earn activity for a Wanchain address, decoded from the Bridge to Earn task board's own events: every successful transaction it sent to the task board and every task board transaction that paid it, with the task's route, the source token and the amount the task asks to bridge, and each asset moved (WAN and tokens, in and out). Newest first with cursor pagination. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.
name: get_address_bridge_to_earn
title: Wanchain address Bridge to Earn activity
